_comment: Demo seed — three trails + one peer, one inherited pin. Narrative: launch is the parent project with two subtrails (v0.1.24 ships now, v1.0-roadmap is what comes after). daily-thinking is a separate peer for reflective writing. The launch checklist pinned on the parent trail appears on every page in the launch family — that's the trail-pin inheritance demo.

pages._: -2d on launch — the planning page. Carries the pinned checklist block.

content.text: two things to ship before the announcement: the flatpak is live on flathub, and the demo content is real. the rest is polish.
tag v0.1.24 and push to gitlab
sync the manifest to the flathub repo
respond to the last review thread
capture screenshots once the demo seed lands
tomorrow's focus is the flathub thread — split into its own subtrail so the back-and-forth has a place.

pages._: today on v0.1.24 — the active subtrail. The launch checklist pin inherits down to here.

content.text: the reviewer left two notes overnight. small, both fixable in one commit.
rename app-id to follow reverse-DNS of shizumu.app
drop the redundant filesystem permission from the manifest
once those land the merge can happen and the announcement post can go out tonight.

pages._: -3d on v1.0-roadmap — what comes after. The pin still inherits here too.

content.text: the v1.0 sync story has to honor the local-first promise. principles:
opt-in: sync is off by default. local-only is the supported mode.
e2e encrypted: the server stores blobs it can't read.
provider-agnostic: speak to s3-compatible storage. user picks.
rough budget: 3-4 months of focused work to get a beta worth shipping.

pages._: -1d on daily-thinking — peer trail, no inheritance from launch. Reflective writing has its own home.

content.text: slept well. cold morning. wrote nothing useful for an hour and that turned out to be the work.
the thing about a tool that refuses to organize for you is that the refusal IS the feature. the structure that comes from writing is shaped by the writing, not the other way around.
today's plan: close the flathub review, draft the post, sleep at a reasonable hour.
